properties.name: A restructuring is certified, not asserted
properties.statement: When a design change claims to move structure while holding function invariant, reflow2 shall decide that claim from the two as-designed records alone — reporting whether anything in the function layer (Capability, Requirement, Flow, Actor, Constraint, Project) was added or removed, and whether any link lying wholly inside that layer was added, removed or changed — and shall refuse to certify a divergence it cannot classify, answering indeterminate rather than passing it silently. A link shall be judged function-bearing by its endpoints and never by its type alone, because one edge type carries different meaning at different endpoints.
